Colorblind filter

Protan helps with red-weak sight, Deutan with green-weak (the most common), Tritan with blue-weak. They recolour the whole game so reds, greens and blues are easier to tell apart.

Fit check

The Closet

Drip is your power.How it works

Every point of Drip adds 1% damage and 0.2 max HP, and new floors drop pieces with more Drip. Wear 2–5 pieces of your class's style for a Fit bonus that multiplies your Drip (five different styles earns Maximalist). Other styles still add their Drip but don't count toward Fit. Drip from a style also powers that style's talents.
